W.note: Solid, tidy page with a live curve picker and a disabled state, but the blurred halo is modest and the hover strip shows no visible change on the captured button, so the dreamlike effect is hard to confirm.

X.note: Aurora conic wash and a slow sheen give the most luminous feel among the quieter entries, though 900ms transitions on filter and box-shadow are heavier to render and the hover evidence is subtle.

Y.note: Restrained custom curves (overshoot lift, long drift on the glow) with a visible halo fade, will-change on the pseudo-element, focus ring, reduced-motion path and a sold-out state make it the most shippable.

Z.note: Layered aurora, sheen and rising sparks read most dreamlike and the hover frames show the bloom clearly, though the 14px blur on an oversized conic layer and backdrop-filter cost more to render.
